name: Jimmy John's
disclaimer_extra: Jimmy John's publishes each add-on and freebie at three portion levels — EZ, regular and XTRA — and republishes the whole set for each bread size, because the same topping is portioned differently on a Little John than on a 16" French. Pick your sandwich first and the add-on list shows the values for that size.
blurb: Start from any Jimmy John's sandwich — Little John, 8" or 16" French, Unwich, sliced wheat or a wrap — then add meats, cheese and freebies at the EZ, regular or XTRA portion the chain actually publishes.

categories.name: Bread & Size
categories.note: Jimmy John's publishes a separate set of figures for each bread, so this decides which sandwiches and which add-on portions apply.

categories.name: Bread
categories.note: Building from scratch: this is the bread on its own. A named sandwich already includes it. Jimmy John's scoops the middle out of its French loaf as standard (their "TBO", take bread out); ask to leave it in and the loaf is the heavier row.

categories.name: Add-ons
categories.note: Every add-on is published at three portions - EZ, regular and XTRA - and the figures differ by bread size.
